lead: Cinematic film still, warm dusty countryside light, olive and sand tones.
notes: Mood-only mini images for jetboot-resistance.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen jetboot-resistance-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish jetboot-resistance-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: country
images.prompt: A wide ordinary land of farms, rivers, forests, mountains and small towns with red roofs.

images.name: occupiers
images.prompt: A grey concrete checkpoint on a country road, a propaganda billboard and a guard tower, overcast.

images.name: resistance
images.prompt: A tidy hidden camp on a green grassy hillside under olive camouflage nets, a radio mast, wooden crates, morning light.

images.name: wobble
images.prompt: A clumsy figure in a red scarf mid-tumble off a wooden guard tower roof, dust and splinters flying.

images.name: region
images.prompt: A paper map of a countryside region on a camp table, pins and pencil marks on scattered sites, lamp light.

images.name: hideout
images.prompt: A cozy hillside hideout at dusk, a radio room glowing, people around a campfire, racks of gear.

images.name: jetboots
images.prompt: Heavy metal boots with small glowing jet nozzles lifting off a dry dirt road, a cloud of pale dust below, blue sky.

images.name: tapes
images.prompt: Old cassette tapes and a portable tape recorder on a wooden shelf in a sunlit barracks, blue-grey and beige tones.

images.name: squad
images.prompt: Five figures in red scarves and goggles walking toward a hill at sunset, seen from behind.

images.name: civilians
images.prompt: Villagers waving from a red-roofed village street as dust settles, a broken checkpoint barrier.
